description.summary: You surround an ally with an aura of envious yellow, enticing foes to attack them.
description.value: You surround an ally with an aura of envious yellow, enticing foes to attack them. Casting this spell on an ally, or yourself, causes any enemy that is able to see the target when the spell is cast to make a Will save or become antagonized to them. When an enemy makes an attack against the target of decoy they are allowed another Will save, this is granted once per round, to remove the antagonized effect. This spell was submitted as a part of the SCC for June 2021 by DeadKingKicker.
